name: South Eastern Dreamers Cricket Club
tagline: Three teams. Two competitions. One club.
intro: Built on brotherhood, discipline, and community pride, South Eastern Dreamers Cricket Club was founded in 2024 to create a premier home for cricketers in Melbourne's South East. From a single Sunday side to three senior squads competing across the ECA and VSCA, we play relentless cricket with integrity, back each other on every delivery, and forge a lasting legacy for the next generation.
vision: To be recognised as a premier cricket club that fosters sporting excellence, nurtures personal growth, and champions inclusivity for all individuals, regardless of age, gender or background.
mission: To provide a holistic cricketing environment that promotes player development, leadership, community spirit and competitive excellence, enabling individuals to reach their potential both on and off the field.

values.name: Inclusivity
values.detail: Welcoming and supporting individuals from all backgrounds.

values.name: Excellence
values.detail: Striving for the highest standards in performance, coaching and administration.

values.name: Integrity
values.detail: Operating with transparency, honesty and respect at all levels.

values.name: Community
values.detail: Building strong connections with local communities.

values.name: Development
values.detail: Focusing on continuous learning, growth and leadership at every stage.

_planComment: Vision, mission and values are taken verbatim from the club's Strategic Development Plan 2025–2030. The plan document refers to the club as 'Dreamers Sports Club'; the club's current name is South Eastern Dreamers Cricket Club and that is what the site uses throughout. Do not paraphrase the vision, mission or values without the committee's agreement.
heroLine: One-day cricket from October through March. Saturdays for the McCarthy and Laws Shields, Sundays for VSCA Grade 4.
_heroLineComment: The line under the club name on the home page. Every claim comes from the results in config/results-*.json: all matches are One Day, and both seasons ran October to March. The shields come from config/season-2026-27.json.

location._comment: Two different places, deliberately. 'suburb' is where the club is registered (Cranbourne East); the home ground is in Endeavour Hills. Anything telling a visitor where to watch cricket should use homeGround, not suburb.

homeGround.name: Singleton Reserve
homeGround._comment: Confirmed by the club. Match cards use the ground NAME to decide which side is home: a game played here lists Dreamers first.

brand._comment: Sampled from public/brand/logo.jpg. Navy shield + chrome lettering; no gold. Mirrored in src/styles/tokens.css as --color-club / --color-accent-tint — change both together.

playhq._comment: Organisation IDs are UUIDs not visible on playhq.com. Ask ECA and VSCA for theirs. Tenant for cricket is 'ca'.

store.name: Dreamers Club Store
store.blurb: Playing shirts, training gear and supporter apparel. Orders go direct to Tradexco and ship to you.

contact._formComment: GitHub Pages cannot process a POST, so the form posts straight to Web3Forms, which emails the submission to the address registered with that access key. The access key is PUBLIC by design — it appears in the page source and that is how Web3Forms works. It is not a secret, but it can be abused: restrict the allowed domain in the Web3Forms dashboard so only this site can post with it. Clear formEndpoint to fall back to a mailto: link.
contact._privacyComment: Club email only. The president's phone number and home address were removed: this repository is public, and CLAUDE.md forbids committing personal phone numbers or addresses. Do not add them back. The home ground in location.homeGround is a public reserve and is fine to publish.
contact._captchaComment: hCaptcha is Web3Forms' free captcha and needs no site key — it proxies through them. ORDER MATTERS: deploy the site with formCaptcha true FIRST, then switch hCaptcha on for this form in the Web3Forms dashboard. The other way round, the backend expects an h-captcha-response the deployed form is not sending yet and submissions are rejected. Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile are Web3Forms Pro features. The botcheck honeypot stays as a second layer.

social._comment: Official club accounts only. Leave null and the link is simply not rendered.

site._comment: Derived automatically by .github/workflows/deploy.yml from the repo name, so these are reference only. Repo: github.com/Wathsara/SEDCC-web -> a project site at https://wathsara.github.io/SEDCC-web/. Add a CNAME file to public/ for a custom domain and the workflow switches over.

sections._comment: Switches for parts of the site that are built but not ready to promote. Setting news to true puts the tab back in the nav and footer and shows the Latest block on the home page. The /news/ pages are always built either way, so any link already shared keeps working.

sponsors._comment: Club sponsors, shown at /sponsors/. A flat list — add as many as you like and the page grid grows. 'logo' is a filename in src/assets/sponsors/ so Astro optimises it. Every field except name is optional. 'mission' and 'vision' are stored but not currently rendered; say the word and the card can show them.
